items.title: Trump Offers Putin Economic Relief in Hopes That Russia Will Return the Favor
items.author: Alan Rappeport
items.content: <article>The Trump administration is ignoring the will of Congress and waiving new Russia sanctions amid fears that high energy prices will cost Republicans in next month’s elections.</article>

items.content: <article>The shooting occurred on Saturday at the 7th Avenue Station on 53rd Street, near Times Square. The Police Department said there have been no arrests.</article>
